item.title: Notebookcheck: Xiaomi's affordable new fitness tracker arrives in more European markets
item.description: The Xiaomi Smart Band 11 can receive notifications from a compatible Xiaomi smartphone and an iPhone simultaneously, alongside offering improved health and fitness tracking. Starting at €59.99 in Europe, the wearable features a 1.72-inch AMOLED display, several premium finishes, and up to 21 days of battery life under light usage.

item.title: Notebookcheck: Xiaomi's unusual open-ear earbuds make their way to Europe
item.description: Xiaomi's official specifications reveal that the Clip earbuds' advertised 38-hour battery life drops to just 25 hours when LHDC 5.0 high-resolution audio is enabled. The open-ear earbuds also feature Apple Find My support, 11 mm dynamic drivers, and a European starting price of €149.99.
